documentType.title: documentType
documentType.description: The type of document the customer is asking for — e.g. "account statement," "invoice," or "receipt." Captured from the customer's message.

requestedDocument.title: requestedDocument
requestedDocument.description: The specific document or file the customer is requesting (e.g. "account statement," "invoice"). Pass the document type from the customer's message; if none is given, pass their request text as-is.
